en: Caramelized Octopus: Grilled and Caramelized Octopus with potato purée and chips is definitely the best choice for foodfans! It’s a fusion style of classic Spanish famous dish Galician octopus. The mixture of the tender potato puree and slightly sweet taste of caramelized octopus will surprise any gourmand.

Fillet steak “Rossini”: The meat fans should try the steak “Rossini” which is made by the special recipe of our Norwegian chef who, definitely, knows all about meat. The flavors mix of the slightly fried meat with foie- gra and the berry red wine source makes your meal experience unforgeable.

Mussel Casserole: For seafood lovers we advise to discover the new taste of fresh mussels, but just with cheese gorgonzola sauce. Have you ever tried it? Then, it will, definitely, one of your best meal experiences!

Grilled fresh Scallops:  Grilled fresh Scallops with truffle cauliflower cream is one more famous signature of our chef for seafood lovers. The tender favour of the truffle cauliflower mousse is a perfect complement of the freshest galician scallops. Just taste it!

Duck foie: Are you a foie fan? Then, you should try our duck foie with caramelized apple which is made by our chef competently. Just the rightest mixture of the sweet berry sauce with slightly salty foie flavor makes it so special meal experience.

Affogato al Café: The famous dessert Affogato al Café perfectly complements your meal experience with us. Vanilla ice mixed with coffee liqueur, caramelized walnuts and espresso coffee just turns into the most delicious light dessert which gets the hearts.
Borsch: Borsch is the most famous Russian traditional dish. It’s a hot soup cooked with meat and different type of vegetables. We serve it with sour cream and garlic croutons.

Dumplings with meat: Dumplings with meat is probably the most common home-made meal in Russia. We cook this plate according to the most traditional recipe and serve it with sour cream or with meat broth, just on your taste.

Pilaf: Pilaf is a traditional dish in asian part of Russia which got the hearts of all Russia! It’s a rice plate fried and cooked with lamb pieces, carrot and garlic on the open fire. We cook it with our traditional family recipe.
Eggplants with vegetables and garlic is perfect meal experience for vegetable lovers. We offer it with rice garnish as a great vegetarian dish.
Je with the fish: It’s a spicy Korean salad with fresh marinated fish by the special recipe with cucumbers and onion. This is a Korean dish really got loved in asian part of Russia during many years.
Manti: Manti is a traditional plate of East Asian cuisine. We cook it with a filling of lamb and pumpkin.
Chak Chak: Chak Chak is a oriental sweetness made of fried dough pieces in honey syrup and walnuts. Traditionally, it becomes a part of the tea ceremony.
